title: ficus aurantiacea var. parvifolia
intro: Ficus aurantiacea var. parvifolia, commonly known as the small-leaved orange fig, is a plant species in the family Moraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ficus aurantiacea var. parvifolia include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
